note: Cleanup verification, per the owner priority "nothing important accidentally deleted". Verified by re-derivation, not by accepting the classification. The keep call is correct and is better than "kept" - the proposal is now TRACKED at HEAD rather than sitting untracked on disk, so it is the one artifact of the six-plus-one that moved from irrecoverable to permanent.  scripts/reports/ was already partly tracked (20 files at HEAD), so this was never a directory-level sweep. TWO ARE NOT REPRODUCIBLE AND ARE PERMANENTLY GONE: pre-write-baseline.json (44K) and scripts/reports/review-baseline.txt (1.0K). I cannot certify these two were safe to delete, because the evidence needed to certify that was inside the files. I am recording the loss rather than implying it was verified.
